sections.title: The task
sections.line: A person shows the whole tissue-pack task once: open the cap, pull a tissue, clear the coffee beans.

sections.title: Marker into the white box
sections.line: Teleoperated demos first, then the first autonomous run (camera + vision model + kinematics).

sections.title: Magnetic duster collects metal caps
sections.line: Grasp the duster, hold it over each cap without pressing, then drop it into the box.

sections.title: Tissue pack: open the flip-top cap
sections.line: Pushing failed, a hand-guided demo worked, its replay half-worked, a sideways sweep opened it autonomously.

sections.title: Pinch and pull one tissue
sections.line: Too deep lifts the whole pack; a thin sheet does not stall the gripper, so only the camera can confirm.

sections.title: Clear the coffee beans
sections.line: Wiping with the tissue spreads the beans; lanes clear the box; pushing the whole pack through them works best.

sections.title: The whole tissue task in one run
sections.line: Cap, tissue and beans chained, with camera checks and retries at each stage.

sections.title: Wooden spoon scoops coffee beans into the cup
sections.line: 24-episode 30 fps LeRobot v3 teleop dataset (table + wrist cameras), plus shifted demo-matching and autonomous runs.

sections.title: Simulation twin & RL policies (MuJoCo)
sections.line: Calibrated 8-servo twin: 100-trial cup pick benchmark (94%) and 30 Hz PPO sideways JOOLA bat ball balancing (93.3% camera) & dribbling.

sections.title: Appendix: not finished, empty or duplicate recordings
sections.line: Kept for completeness. Not in the slide deck or the highlight reel.

items.title: Reference: a person does the task by hand
items.note: Recorded with the table camera (15 fps): the person opens the cap, pulls a tissue and sweeps the beans. This is the goal the robot works towards.

items.title: Teleop demo take 2: marker into the box
items.note: A person moves the leader arm, the follower copies it. The marker ends inside the white box. LeRobot episode 0, the good training episode.

items.title: Teleop demo take 1: placed wrongly
items.note: Same task, the operator placed the marker wrongly. Kept as a labelled failure example (episode 1), not trained on as a success.

items.title: First autonomous run: the arm pushed the box
items.note: The table mapping had x mirrored relative to the kinematics, so each visual correction moved the arm further the wrong way and the jaws pushed the box about 12 cm. Found and fixed the same evening (tip-based calibration).

items.title: Duster grasped first try, both caps taken, into the box
items.note: Grasp on the first try (1888 ticks, 318 mA), held over each of the 2 caps with no pressing, camera check: 0 caps left on the table, then released into the white box. Matches the 'final run' in docs/RESULTS.md. Not confirmed by the human in OUTCOME.json.

items.title: Duster run: only one of two caps taken
items.note: User: not successful, only one of the two caps was taken, the other stayed on the table. The detector had seen only 1 cap.

items.title: Duster run: grasp on the third try, stopped before the box
items.note: User: not both caps taken, duster not placed in the box (run stopped before the bin). Two empty closes (1324 ticks, 0 mA) before a hold on try 3.

items.title: Duster run (8 fps recorder)
items.note: Duster grasped and carried into the box; a small object, probably one cap, seems to remain on the table. No log for this recording.

items.title: Duster session, 6 minutes (8 fps recorder)
items.note: Several duster attempts and resets in one long recording, no log. Trimmed and sped up here.

items.title: Pushing the lid: the vision model said 'open', it was closed
items.note: The lid was still closed in a clean photo; the vision model's 'open: true' was a false positive because the arm hid the lid. Lesson: never trust a model yes/no for physical success.

items.title: Pushing the lid: pressed down instead of lifting
items.note: Lid stayed closed; the closed gripper pressed down on the pack and nudged it. User: wrong, the lid must be opened upward, not pressed down.

items.title: Hand-guided demo: the lid opened by a sideways lift
items.note: Torque off, a person moves the follower arm by hand while it records. The flip-top lid ends open with the tissue visible. No leader arm needed.

items.title: Robot replays the hand demo: lid semi-open
items.note: Replay at 0.8x of the recorded demo with lag and current watchdogs. The pack was about 2 cm right of the demo position: the lid ended semi-open. Marked success with 'not a full open'.

items.title: Stepped-down sweeps: cap stayed closed
items.note: Cap stayed closed; the sweep path drifted about 5 cm forward instead of sideways and the tip was judged too deep.

items.title: Sweep from the top, 3 attempts: cap stayed closed
items.note: Cap stayed closed after 3 sweeps (z 0.072-0.080); the path drifted forward and the tip was too deep.

items.title: Sweep from the top: stopped during attempt 2
items.note: The camera reported the cap still closed after attempt 1; the run ended during attempt 2.

items.title: Sweep from the top, 3 attempts: cap would not open
items.note: Three sweeps at z 0.078/0.074/0.070; the cap is closed in the final frame and the script gave up.

items.title: Autonomous sideways sweep opens the cap
items.note: The cap was opened autonomously by the sideways sweep (attempt 3, tip z 0.081). The tissue was then pulled out by hand-commanded steps, not by the script.

items.title: Gripped too deep: lifted the whole pack
items.note: Grasp at z 0.052 closed on the pack itself (1399 ticks, 46 mA) and lifted it. The script's own 'DONE - tissue pulled' was wrong. User: pick from the top, at the tip.

items.title: Three pinches at the tip: all closed on nothing
items.note: Pack put down first; 3 pinch tries (z 0.068/0.074/0.080) closed on nothing (1325-1340 ticks, under 5 mA); the pack was twisted and the lid closed afterwards.

items.title: Hand-guided pinch demo: no tissue in the jaws
items.note: The robot's one close ended at 1326 ticks / 0 mA (nothing between the jaws). At the end a person picks up a loose tissue from the table.

items.title: Tissue pinched at the tip and pulled straight up
items.note: Jaws lowered a little onto the tissue (tip z 0.076 at the true pack position), closed, pulled straight up; the photos show a tissue lifted out and carried to the home position, then released. The close read 1334 ticks / 2 mA: a thin sheet does not stall the gripper.

items.title: Wipe with the tissue: beans spread into a streak
items.note: One pass with the tissue held in the gripper spread the beans into a diagonal streak; about 16 beans left.

items.title: Three wipe passes: more bean pixels after than before
items.note: Dark bean pixels in the bean box went from 355 to 716-763: the wipes spread the beans instead of clearing them.

items.title: L-shaped sweeps: a few beans moved
items.note: Three L sweeps took the bean box from 397 to 319 dark pixels; most beans are still there in the video.

items.title: Vacuum-pattern lanes: the bean box is cleared
items.note: Five lanes, each stroke toward image-left with lifted returns: the bean box went from 312 to 15 dark pixels, but the beans were pushed out of the box and scattered to the side rather than collected.

items.title: One more lane: 195 to 140 bean pixels
items.note: A single extra lane over the remaining beans moved a few of them.

items.title: Push the whole pack through the beans in one stroke
items.note: The closed gripper at the tissue case's left corner pushed the whole case 21 cm sideways through the grouped beans. The beans ended against the case's side; the user said the intention is clear and one more push would clear them. Saved as a demo.

items.title: Fast full run: cap not opened, stopped at the beans
items.note: Cap swept but not opened; the tissue close read empty; stopped at the first bean lane (IK cannot reach).

items.title: Retry loop: no tissue after three pinches
items.note: A person's hand touches the pack during the cap stage; then three tissue pinches (z 0.092/0.086/0.080) found nothing and the run ended.

items.title: Retry loop: cap not confirmed open
items.note: Two sweeps changed the picture too little (5.1 and 7.1, open needs more than 9); the run ended at the first tissue attempt.

items.title: Guided session: cap opened and one tissue pulled
items.note: The human gives short chat commands, the arm executes them: cap opened with a sideways sweep at one height, then one tissue pinched and pulled straight up. The bean lanes at the end missed the pile and are not part of the success.

items.title: Autonomous: cap open and tissue out on the first try
items.note: One sweep at tip z 0.103 opened the cap (picture change 26.9), the first pinch took a tissue and pulled it straight up and out; the video shows the tissue out of the pack. No bean cluster was detected, so the bean stage did not run.

items.title: Autonomous with retries: cap on try 2, tissue on try 3
items.note: The cap opened on the second sweep; two pinches found nothing (the camera check caught it and retried), the third was reported held and pulled. In the final frame the tissue is raised but not clearly out of the pack.

items.title: Autonomous: cap + tissue, then the bean lanes pushed the pack
items.note: Cap opened and a tissue was pulled up; during the 8 bean lanes the pack was pushed into the beans and a person stepped in.

items.title: Teleop demo (30 fps): scoop beans into the black cup
items.note: Clean 30.0 fps LeRobot v3 teleop episode (0 stale frames): follower grasps the wooden spoon from the bowl, scoops coffee beans, carries them to the black cup and pours them in. Part of the 24-episode spoon_beans_v1 dataset.

items.title: Teleop demo take 2 (30 fps): scoop and pour
items.note: Second user-confirmed 30.0 fps teleop training episode (0 stale frames, 41.6 s): clean handle grasp, scoop and pour into the black cup.

items.title: Teleop demo take 3 (30 fps): scoop and pour
items.note: Third user-confirmed 30.0 fps teleop training episode (0 stale frames, 49.1 s).

items.title: Shifted demo match: grasps spork and carries beans
items.note: Measured handle in camera, shifted demo ep4 by [+7, +4, -3] cm, grasped under load (1355 ticks, 97 mA), scooped beans from the bowl and carried them to the black cup (~10 beans + spork dropped beside the cup rim).

items.title: Autonomous alignment: closed without lifting spoon
items.note: Vision aligned above the handle, but the jaws closed without lifting the wooden spoon out of the bowl and ran the pour motion empty.

items.title: Single-shot 0.8x trajectory replay
items.note: Blind 0.8x replay of a recorded trajectory; the bowl/spoon position differed slightly from the demo so the spoon stayed in the bowl.

items.title: Sim: autonomous cup pick & 3s hold (94/100)
items.note: Calibrated MuJoCo 3.2.7 twin with +-3 cm mapping noise removed by 2-step wrist-camera 3D ray-plane alignment (4.96 mm median error).

items.title: Sim: 30 Hz PPO JOOLA bat balance (93.3% cam)
items.note: Matched 1:1 to the real sideways JOOLA bat grip (gripper=0.341); calibration-free red-ellipse + ball front-camera tracker + FdVel3D under 0-100 ms lag.

items.title: Sim: 30 Hz PPO JOOLA bat dribbling (max 22)
items.note: Warm-started from the balance policy with hollow-shell ball inertia, air drag, and min_rise >= 3.5 cm anti-buzz gating.

items.title: Scissors: hand-taught orientation (1)
items.note: Hand-guided soft-hold session to show the scissors orientation. The tape cut was never made.

items.title: Scissors: hand-taught orientation (2)
items.note: Second soft-hold session for the scissors.

items.title: Scissors: lift, 10 open/close cycles, move toward the boxes
items.note: Guided session: the arm lifted the scissors level, ran 10 open/close cycles (every close stalled on the scissors loops, 1625-1764 ticks), then moved toward the tape between the boxes, where the shoulder could not hold the height. Video capped at 400 s by the recorder.

items.title: Scissors: cutting pose taught by hand
items.note: The cutting pose was saved while the person held the arm (run/scissors_cut_pose.json). After release the arm sagged about 2 cm.

items.title: Scissors: back to the taught pose, the scissors slipped out
items.note: Small goal pushes brought the tip from 11.1 to 12.5 cm; the scissors, resting in open jaws, slipped out during the lift. The arm was then parked. Video capped at 400 s by the recorder.
